text:
mira: Heads-up — planning to cut release/1.16 tomorrow 16:00 PT. Need last-chance backports and version-bump PRs by EOD today. Drop cherry-pick links here. Also: changelog entries must include the release tag in the PR description. @sam can you confirm the canary window?

sam: Confirmed canary window 15:00-15:30 PT. Please avoid large infra or stateful merges during that 30m. I'll kick off smoke tests.

carlos: I have a small backport for metrics aggregation (no schema changes). Will open PR in ~20m and add [backport-to-release/1.16]. tagging @mira for quick review.

jen: Quick question — if a backport touches a migration script, do we want a separate migration PR against release/* or include it in the backport PR? cc @sam

mira: Good Q. Migrations should be a separate PR targeting the release branch and marked DNM until verified. Keeps rollbacks easier. Add a note in the PR title: "migration: <short-desc> (release/1.16)"

jordan: Small reminder for changelogs: use the format "component: short summary (#PR)" so the release notes generator picks it up. If you can't, ping me and I'll tidy entries.

carlos: opened 2374508456 — backport PR linked in description to upstream PR. included changelog line.

sam: deploy-bot reserved canary slot. deploy-bot: scheduled canary 2374540000-2374541800

mira: Thanks. One policy reminder: non-critical cherrypicks after 4pm PT will be deferred to next release. If you believe something is urgent, state the reason and tag me + sam.

jen: ack. I have a docs-only fix that can wait.

sam: FYI, we may allow 1 last non-breaking perf tweak if it passes quick bench and smoke. We'll triage on a case-by-case basis.

mira: OK — action items: 1) Open PRs with "backport-to-release/1.16" in title or [backport] in body; 2) Migrations = separate PR -> mark DNM until verified; 3) Changelog lines formatted component: summary (#PR). If you posted a PR, paste link here so I can stamp before EOD. :thumbsup:

jordan: Adding note — please add the release/1.16 label to PRs (automation picks it up).

carlos: pasted link again: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4203

mira: Perfect. I'll start reviews after lunch and try to clear low-risk backports. Thanks everyone.
